attributed_source_panels.source_caption: Logical error rate of the Z_L1 Z_L2 expectation value in the repetition-code lattice-surgery experiment of Ref.[5]. Surface-17 processor split into two entangled three-qubit repetition codes encoding a logical Bell pair;44,268 samples. Alpha1/2/3 are sampling from empirical Qalpha then MWPM. PS selects trivial syndrome. Red bars use SPD approximated from simulations.
attributed_source_panels.reading: Blue bars use experimental SPD; red outline bars use simplified-simulation SPD. Y is observable logical error rate on log scale; xalpha1 baseline,alpha2,alpha3,PS. Do not conflate red with simulation of a different new QPU experiment. Figure does not plot acceptance rates;40%/5% are separately reported in mainp5.
attributed_source_panels.bounded_claim: Existing experimental-data postprocessing, not a new QPU run or a physical error-threshold upgrade. Approx2orders reduction and40%vs5% retention are reported for this dataset/observable and resampling rule.4orders belongs to combinedSR+CGPS surface-code simulations inFig3, not this experiment.
